اندفعت (form VII)
# اِنْدَفَعْتُ (indafaʕtu) /in.da.faʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْدَفَعَ (indafaʕa)
# اِنْدَفَعْتَ (indafaʕta) /in.da.faʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْدَفَعَ (indafaʕa)
# اِنْدَفَعْتِ (indafaʕti) /in.da.faʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْدَفَعَ (indafaʕa)
# اِنْدَفَعَتْ (indafaʕat) /in.da.fa.ʕat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
